name: Neo-deco
summary: Art Deco after a century, made soft. Curved bouclé and velvet seats, fluted wood, arches, ribbed glass and brushed brass keep the geometry and the glamour of the 1920s, but in warm, muted colours and rounded forms.

philosophy.core_thesis: Deco glamour without the hard edges: curves, ribs and warm metal make luxury feel soft and personal.
design_principles: Round every form: curved sofas, arched mirrors and doorways, pill-shaped tables.
Use ribs and flutes as the main ornament: fluted wood, reeded glass, ribbed plaster.
Keep the palette warm and muted: terracotta, sage, ochre, burgundy and cream with brushed brass.
Place one curved seat group in the centre of the room, not against the walls.
Use one or two glamorous materials, such as velvet and brass, with matt plaster.
Light with globe and mushroom lamps and with arched niches lit from inside.
anti_patterns: High-gloss black lacquer on large walls

composition.plan_logic: An open room with a curved seat group that floats in the centre on a round rug. Arched niches and a fluted wall frame it; the rest stays calm.
composition.focal_point: A curved velvet sofa and a round fluted table on a round rug in the centre of the room.

rules.rule: Float a curved seat group in the centre of the room on a round rug.
Repeat flutes and ribs on wood, glass and plaster at a fine pitch.
Repeat the arch and the circle at 3 scales: doorway, mirror and table.
Centre the arched niches or the mirror on the seat group, but let the loose pieces stay free.
Keep contrast medium: warm muted tones with brass highlights.
Frame doors, mirrors and shelves with arches.
Give a warm plaster tone the walls, one muted colour the upholstery and brass and dark wood the accents.
Use globe and mushroom lamps and light the niches from inside; keep the ceiling quiet.
Keep a ring route around the centre group.
Shoot the room level, with a three-quarter view on the centre group with an arch behind it.

zones: arched niche with bar or shelves
zoning.circulation: A ring route around the round rug.

palette.distribution: Warm plaster walls; terracotta, sage or burgundy velvet and bouclé; fluted walnut; brushed brass in lamps and trims.

lighting.strategy: Soft globe light and lit niches; brass and ribbed glass make warm, diffuse sparkle.
lighting.daylight: Daylight through linen sheers on a curved track; reeded glass screens soften it further.

layers.source: opal glass globe pendant with brass
mushroom table lamp in ribbed glass
LED strip inside the arched niches
linen sheers on a curved track

materials.finish: Matt plaster, satin wood, brushed metal; no high gloss on large surfaces.
materials.texture_contrast: Soft bouclé and velvet against ribbed wood and smooth plaster, at about 1:1.

furniture.silhouette: Curved and rounded pieces: crescent sofas, barrel chairs, pill and drum tables, all low and soft.
furniture.arrangement: One curved group floats in the centre on a round rug; arched shelves line one wall.

textiles.pattern: Few patterns: a fan or arch motif on a rug, or a quiet geometric in one tone.
textiles.windows: Linen sheers on a curved track, floor to ceiling.

objects.approach: A few sculptural pieces: ribbed glass, brass, travertine and one deco-style print.
objects.grouping: Groups of 3 on niche shelves, curved and straight forms mixed.

implementation.brief: A warm plaster room with arched niches and a fluted walnut wall. A curved terracotta velvet sofa, two sage bouclé barrel chairs and a round fluted table float on a round rug under an opal globe pendant.
implementation.image_prompt: Neo-deco living room, warm plaster walls, arched lit niches, fluted walnut wall panel, curved terracotta velvet sofa, two sage boucle barrel chairs, round fluted wood coffee table on a round rug, opal glass globe pendant with brushed brass, ribbed glass mushroom lamp, arched mirror, travertine side table, warm muted palette, soft glamorous light, contemporary Art Deco revival, interior photograph
implementation.negative_prompt: Sharp corners, black lacquer walls, cold light, rustic, primary colours, clutter.
implementation.camera: 28 mm lens at 120 cm, three-quarter view on the centre group with an arch behind it.
implementation.scene_3d: Room 600 x 500 cm, ceiling 280 cm. 2700 K globe pendant at 210 cm; 2400 K strips in 3 niches; velvet and bouclé with sheen 0.3.
furniture_list: curved sofa 260 x 100 x 75 cm, seat 42 cm
fluted table 100 cm round x 38 cm

emotion.target_response: Soft glamour: the viewer feels pampered and a little elegant, in a warm and rounded room.

avoid_when: The brief asks for a rustic or technical room.
The budget does not allow curved custom upholstery.

modifiers.how: Add black lacquer, macassar ebony, chrome and a strict symmetric plan; sharpen the contrast.
Remove the colour, keep the curves in greige bouclé and travertine, and reduce the brass.

sources.title: Trend evidence, cite only: design press and image platforms describe a deco revival from about 2020, a century after 1920
